title: 'I have +1 [Might] for each friendly gear' does not scale with gear count
expected: Ornn (sfd-085-221) has no hand-authored abilities; enrich-cards.ts parses rulesText into a static ability `{type:"modify-might", amount:1, per:"friendly gear", target:"self"}` (verified by running parseAbilities). The engine's applyStaticEffect in riftbound-engine/src/abilities/static-abilities.ts:492-517 only computes `amount` from a numeric literal, `cardsInTrash`, or `score`; it never reads `effect.per` (no reference to `per` anywhere in static-abilities.ts or the abilities/ dir). So `amount = 1` is applied flat at line 547-551 (`staticMightBonus: current + targetAmount`), regardless of friendly gear count — matching the observed staticMightBonus=1 / Effective Might 5.
observed: meta.staticMightBonus stayed at 1 and UI 'Effective Might' showed 5 with 2 friendly gear (2x Serrated Dirk, one attached) and still 5 after a 3rd gear (Hand Hammer + Seal of Rage + Sun Disc in first run). Bonus is a flat +1 regardless of gear count.
